Name: (CP) E'ming
Author: xtobefreex
Description:
[u][b]OVERVIEW:[/b][/u]
(Baby's first mod that adds a new item to the game! Woohoo!)

E'ming is sold in Krobus' shop for 500,000 gold, with stats comparable to the Infinity Blade but just a [i]bit [/i]better, to match the lore of the sword 😉. The sword will be located towards the bottom of the list of items they are selling.
 
[b]Real talk[/b]: I know E'ming is expensive, especially when you consider the fact that you can buy Galaxy weapons from Marlon for 75,000 gold, but I figured that things could be adjusted with feedback if need be. I didn't want a super strong weapon to be very easy to obtain, but maybe you'll get lucky and find it around floors 80-85 in the mines! I tried for a while and couldn't get it, but the coding is there.
I initially wanted it to be obtained by trading an Ancient Sword, but I couldn't quite figure that out, so I'm happy with just having it in the shop as it is.

* Please be gentle about any comments concerning the pixel art, I am in no way a pixel artist and tried my best ;; The design I went with for E'ming leans more closely towards the manhua, but there are elements from the donghua design mixed in. Because this is my first real mod for the game, any issues that you might have with the mod, I may or may not be able to troubleshoot. [b]Thank you for downloading![/b]
[b][u]
[/u]DO NOT [/b]reupload this as your own work in any shape or form. If anyone is interested in making a translation for the mod in their language, please let me know, and [i]please[/i] link back to this original post [u]after[/u] I have given you the okay to post it.

[u][b]Installation:[/b][/u]
1. Make sure you have the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed. 
2. Unzip the folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
3. Run the game through the SMAPI launcher.

[b][u]Compatibility:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod is intended for Stardew Valley version 1.6 or later versions. 
[*]This mod has been tested in single-player and works perfectly fine; multiplayer has not been tested but [i]should[/i] work. Please make sure all players have the mod to prevent possible errors.
[*]This mod will run with other mods that add weapons, as it uses its own unique ID. This is not a retexture of any item.
[/list]
